suppress.notes: Suppress CVE-2026-29062 for tools.jackson.core on Spring Boot 4.0.3. Upgrading to Jackson 3.1.0+ causes ExceptionInInitializerError (NoClassDefFoundError) due to a framework mismatch with Jackson 2.x annotations expecting JsonSerializeAs. Waiting for Spring Boot upstream upgrade.

Suppress DOMPurify mXSS vulnerabilities reported within swagger-ui-bundle.js. This is an upstream issue in springdoc-openapi's embedded swagger-ui distribution. Since Swagger UI is primarily used in dev or internal environments to render our own specs, the XSS risk from malicious definitions is negligible.
